bug_info.bug_desc: The combinational default clears nmi_mode_d instead of retaining the active NMI-handler state. After an NMI entry, nmi_mode_q is therefore cleared on the next ordinary DECODE cycle. A continuously asserted irq_nm_i becomes eligible again and causes repeated interrupt entry before an MRET has ended the handler. This can repeatedly redirect execution and overwrite saved trap state.
bug_info.fix_hint: Change the default assignment of `nmi_mode_d` from `1'b0` to `nmi_mode_q` so that the NMI mode register retains its current value unless explicitly modified (e.g., set to 1 when entering NMI mode in IRQ_TAKEN, or cleared to 0 when exiting NMI mode via MRET in FLUSH).
